title: Restore configurable DB pool size (revert hard-coded pool_size)
description:
Fixes INC-0406.

`db/database.py` hard-coded `pool_size=5` and `max_overflow=0`, bypassing the configured `db_pool_size=20` / `db_max_overflow=10`. Each pod could hold at most 5 connections, so at peak traffic requests queued for a connection and failed after the 3s pool timeout.

The problem was introduced by PR-1501 ("Reduce idle DB connections per pod"), shipped in DEP-0296 (payment-service v2.8.1).

## Changes
- `services/payment-service/payment_service/db/database.py` (+2/-3)

## Testing
- Reproduced the failure in staging before the change
- Verified the fix in staging under replayed production traffic
